thread:
Anika: Poll — which model would you trust to water the office succulents? pick one or add your own. options: Redwood-mini, Llama-3, Claude-Instruct, GPT-X, Opt-Omni. :seedling:
Sam: Redwood-mini. Meticulous scheduling, won’t drown them. :white_check_mark:
Leila: Llama-3 would write a haiku for each plant and then forget to actually water it. 
Owen: Claude-Instruct — sets a calendar reminder and follows a checklist. responsible vibes. :calendar:
Maria: vote: GPT-X but with a safety shim. it will over-explain why humidity matters and then ask clarifying q’s. :sweat_smile:
Dexter: Opt-Omni would try to optimize for growth, then repurpose the kitchen sink. :thinking_face:
Jen: Redwood-mini + a moisture sensor = perfect partnership. we should give it a tiny watering can emoji next to its name. :seedling::small_blue_diamond:
Leila: also imagine the plants getting bedtime stories from Llama-3. adorable but low ROI. :joy:
polly-bot: Poll results so far — Redwood-mini: 3, Claude-Instruct: 1, GPT-X: 1, Llama-3: 1, Opt-Omni: 1. (poll open for 24h) :bar_chart:
Anika: Nice, looks like Redwood-mini wins the short straw. I’ll add a calendar rotation and we’ll pair it with a moisture sensor. thanks for the votes and the poetry. :seedling::smile:
Sam: can someone make a tiny plant-care SOP? 1–2 lines. i’ll paste it on the fridge. :memo:
Jen: SOP suggestion: check soil, water 1 small cup if dry, log waterings in #office-log. done. :heavy_check_mark:
Dexter: also: if plant starts whispering model evals, that’s our cue to increase sunlight, not water. :rofl:
